description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Sharpshooter], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, causes [DEF, RES and MND -30% (8s)]/[DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)]/[DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive, grants [High Quick Cast 1]/[Instant Cast 1] to all allies if 2-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive
